improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating the value proposition and free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, consistent previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter—critical channels for reaching business professionals. Including the price anchor and free searches creates urgency and transparency.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace for your business operations. Try three searches free — no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately introduces Gideon by name while clearly stating what it does (AI trade and business assistant). The subheading reinforces three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) and removes friction by highlighting the free trial with no payment barrier. The copy is direct, builds trust, and creates a low-risk entry point for conversion.

improvements.suggestion:
**Q: What happens after my three free searches?**

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to choose a membership plan to continue. Plans start at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30% with annual billing. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common conversion barrier—uncertainty about what happens at the paywall. It transparently explains the transition from trial to paid, reinforces affordability, and highlights member benefits, reducing friction and building trust at a critical decision point.
